faqs.question: Are robot vacuums worth it for pet owners?
faqs.answer: Yes, running a robot vacuum daily prevents pet hair and dander from building up and embedding into carpets.

faqs.question: Is LiDAR better than camera navigation for robot vacuums?
faqs.answer: LiDAR offers faster, more accurate mapping in dark or lit rooms, while camera-based systems excel at object and pet waste recognition.
